description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for merging functionality in Git, including different strategies like resolve, recursive, octopus, ours, and subtree. It simulates various merge scenarios such as trivial merges, non-trivial merges, related and unrelated files, staged changes, and conflict handling.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generate a sequence of numbers, used to create branch contents.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advance the timestamp for commit metadata.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Define a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Define a test case that should fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Assert that a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Assert that a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Search for a pattern in output.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Custom test utility, e.g., for changing file modification time.
